How three startups grew inside Aurora

Hiring, funding and a few wins from our members.

EElena Navarro12 March 2026

Good writing starts with a clear question. In this article we explore the idea in plain language, with examples you can use straight away.

The first thing to understand is that small decisions compound. Choosing carefully at the start saves far more time than it costs, and it makes every later step easier.

We have tested these approaches with real clients over several years. Some worked immediately; others needed adjusting. Here is what we learned.

Three things to remember

  • Start with the outcome you want.
  • Test small before you commit.
  • Write down what you learn.

pages.faq:
Home/FAQ
Help

FAQ

Answers to the questions we hear most.

Can I try before I commit?

Yes. Book a tour and we will give you a free day pass to try the space.

What is included in membership?

Fibre internet, coffee and tea, printing credits, meeting-room hours and access to member events.

Is the space open 24 hours?

Resident and Studio members have 24/7 access. Flex members use the space 8 am to 10 pm.

How do meeting rooms work?

Book from the member app. Rooms have screens, video conferencing and whiteboards.

Can I cancel my membership?

Monthly plans can be cancelled with 30 days' notice. Studios have a six-month minimum.

Do you offer virtual offices?

Yes, with a registered address, mail handling and 4 free meeting-room hours a month.

Still have questions?

Our team is happy to help.

Contact us
